Build scope

What Retail Fit-Out includes

Every decision supports merchandise, movement and brand recognition. The result is a store that looks clear and works hard.

01Customer flowPlan product zones, circulation and conversion points.
02ShopfrontEntrance, fascia, glass, doors and signage.
03Display joineryCustom shelving, counters and product fixtures.
04Retail lightingTrack, spotlight, ambient and feature lighting.
05Feature ceilingsBranded panels, illuminated details and service coordination.
06Brand graphicsWall applications, murals, signs and wayfinding.
07FlooringVinyl, tile and wood-look commercial surfaces.
08Back of houseStockroom, storage and staff support areas.

A controlled programme

6 steps from brief to handover

Decisions are approved in sequence so the site team can build with fewer changes and clearer accountability.

01

Survey and brief

Measure the unit and understand brand, product and customer needs.

02

Brand design and 3D

Approve the layout, shopfront, displays, lighting and finishes.

03

Procurement

Source materials and manufacture branded joinery in-house.

04

Construction and MEP

Build partitions, ceilings, floors, power, HVAC and services.

05

Branding and finishing

Install displays, graphics, signage and focused lighting.

06

Handover

Snag, correct and release a customer-ready store.

Indicative PKR pricing

A practical range before the survey

These planning figures come from the service scope. The proposal is fixed only after site review and specification approval.

Basic RetailPKR 5,000–7,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 7.5M–10.5M
Mid-Spec RetailPKR 7,000–9,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 10.5M–13.5M
Luxury ShowroomPKR 10,000–15,000 / sq. ft.
PKR 15M–22.5M

Examples use a 1,500 sq. ft. unit. The fixed quote follows the site survey and selected specification.

Practical answers

Retail Fit-Out FAQs

Six short answers about scope, timing and cost.

A 1,500 sq. ft. retail unit typically ranges from PKR 7.5M to 22.5M, depending on specification, shopfront and custom displays.

A standard retail unit takes 5–7 weeks. A chain prototype can take 7–10 weeks, with later locations often faster.

Yes. We develop a repeatable prototype for shopfronts, displays, lighting, finishes and signage.

Yes. We work to your approved colours, materials, logo use, signage and display standards.

Yes. Woodex Furniture™ manufactures custom display units, shelving, counters, feature walls and storage.

items.q: How much does a retail fit-out cost?
items.a: A 1,500 sq. ft. retail unit typically ranges from PKR 7.5M to 22.5M, depending on specification, shopfront and custom displays.
A standard retail unit takes 5–7 weeks. A chain prototype can take 7–10 weeks, with later locations often faster.

items.q: Can you fit out several locations?
items.a: Yes. We develop a repeatable prototype for shopfronts, displays, lighting, finishes and signage.

items.q: Can you follow our brand guidelines?
items.a: Yes. We work to your approved colours, materials, logo use, signage and display standards.

items.q: How is fit-out different from renovation?
items.a: Fit-out builds a new shell into a working store. Renovation upgrades an existing retail space.

items.q: Can Woodex make the displays and counters?
items.a: Yes. Woodex Furniture™ manufactures custom display units, shelving, counters, feature walls and storage.
